description: The SSC Tuatara achieved a verified 295mph with Johnny Bohmer Proving Grounds at Space Florida’s LLF, Kennedy Space Center, Merritt, Florida on 14th May 2022. This was measured using a VBOX Touch RTK and VBOX Video HD2 installed and checked by RACELOGIC Technical Director Jim Lau.
